local last_theme = nil

local music_track_indices = {}

local last_music_change_time = 0

local music_change_interval = 6



for themeName, _ in pairs(theme_data) do

    music_track_indices[themeName] = 1

end



function onOutput(triggerId)

    local count = getChatLength(triggerId)

    if count == 0 then return end



    local chat = getFullChat(triggerId)

    local lastMessage = chat[count]

    local outputText = lastMessage.data



    if not outputText then return end



    local theme = string.match(outputText, "Theme%s*:%s*(%w+)")

    if not theme then

        theme = string.match(outputText, "Location%s*:%s*(%w+)")

        if not theme then return end

    end



    local themeInfo = theme_data[theme]

    if not themeInfo then return end



    local music_tracks = themeInfo.music_tracks

    if not music_tracks then return end



    local shouldChange = (theme ~= last_theme)

    local current_time = os.time()

    local track_index = music_track_indices[theme]

    local musicToPlay = music_tracks[track_index]



    if shouldChange or (current_time - last_music_change_time >= music_change_interval) then

        if not shouldChange then

            track_index = track_index + 1

            if track_index > #music_tracks then

                track_index = 1

            end

            music_track_indices[theme] = track_index

            musicToPlay = music_tracks[track_index]

        end



        local embedding = "{{audio::" .. musicToPlay .. "}}"

        setBackgroundEmbedding(triggerId, embedding)



        last_music_change_time = current_time

        last_theme = theme

    end

end
